_about: Ranks & emblems fragment (List 30 #295) — Adventure grammar native: ranks as a DERIVED scoring overlay over existing completion records; emblems as #104 honour facts displayed in #98's licence presentation beside the Fragment case. Zero tables or emblems instanced.

emblems.awarded_at: authored milestones (climb cleared, circuits completed, rank ceiling reached, HEAD bested, care-sport championship class) — milestone lists are content
emblems.display: #98 licence presentation, beside the Fragment case; #238 card family in the show — every emblem shown must correspond to a milestone the fiction gave (casting honesty)
emblems.form: an honour fact in #104's family naming individual + milestone
emblems.never: consumed, traded, lost, or fenced (#274) — non-transferable by shape; emblems are not items
emblems.set_unlock: CONTENT SLOT — the mechanic is counting + display; whether an authored total opens anything is canon decided with the facilities; none asserted

ranks.changes: nothing but honour surfaces — may feed #104 occasions; never gates progress, never alters earned rewards, never re-opens a completion
ranks.form: a rank table (authored thresholds per activity family, data) scored over the completion's own recorded facts
never_ranked: ceremonies — their homes carry no scoring facts; the refusal is by construction
ranks.scale: five letter ranks, low to high, + one top class above the highest letter at the table's ceiling (closed scale; display names are #23 text data, a naming pass)
ranks.stored: NEVER — derived at read (#14 law); no table, no rank
